results.title: ‎Gifted for CogAT, CCAT & OLSAT App - App Store
results.content:
This app used to be great last year but they must have changed their level of support because I returned to use it again this year to help my daughter prepare for her CoGat test and I cannot change the grade anymore like I used to be able to. It’s permanently stuck on first grade and from what I’ve read researching to fix it- this is a known issue, so if your child is not in first grade you will need to email support and wait for them to manually change the grade. When I hit the “contact” button 3/4 times a pop up told me an error occurred and I needed to try again (this is after I had typed out my support request so very frustrating). Then today I received an email from support telling me to follow the same steps that worked last year but no longer work because most of the app [...] Developer Response

  Hi Wmm14, We are very sorry for the frustration caused. The grade change issue you mentioned is a known bug, and our team is actively working on fixing it - it will be sorted soon. We truly value your support and patience as we work to improve the app experience.
 ### App stopped working

  Whittier20

  We subscribed to the premium version of the app, it has provided good test preparation materials until it stopped working today. We couldn’t load any of the contents, whether it’s daily tests, practice tests, or revisions. We tried removing and reinstalling the app on a different device and we couldn’t even log on. Please fix the issue asap.

  Developer Response [...] worked last year but no longer work because most of the app unfortunately seems to be glitching now. It’s too bad because this app used to work great but if you cannot access the correct grade level because it’s now so buggy it’s pretty much worthless. Also be careful because it auto renews, I recently realized I’ve been paying since last year when I thought I bought a single 3 month subscription.
